# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an elderly woman who is thin, prim, and rigid in her bearing. She has a wrinkled cheek and sharp black eyes that retain their brightness despite her growing age.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim, proper, and notably selfish old lady who rarely cares for anyone other than herself. Despite her sharp tongue and critical disposition, she remains a hospitable hostess who treats her guests royally.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## History

Josephine Barry, an elderly resident of [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), first encountered [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed. Though initially enraged to the point of planning an early departure and canceling Diana's music lessons, Miss Barry was thoroughly charmed by Anne's sincere apology and imaginative nature, choosing to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and become her lifelong friend. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her town home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), during the local [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), and continued to offer hospitality and support to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Proud of Anne's achievements, Miss Barry attended her commencement ceremony to celebrate her winning the Avery scholarship. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) needed a specific item, Miss Barry sent out a willowware platter from her collection, having paid twenty dollars for it and warning [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to care for it properly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "I don’t think you are a fit little girl for Diana to associate with. You’d better go home and behave yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine first met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when the girl accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed at Diana's house, initially causing immense rage. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) boldly visited her to deliver a candid and imaginative apology, Josephine was completely charmed and chose to extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two grew into close friends, with Josephine inviting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay at her town home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and later expressing proud admiration for Anne's achievements at commencement.

- Friend of — expressed pride in her achievements at commencement  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine is Diana's formidable grand-aunt who regularly visits the family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Although she initially threatened to cancel Diana's music lessons after a bedtime prank went wrong, she ultimately forgave her and hosted [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a trip to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). During the visit, she welcomed them to her house, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), and treated them to outings at the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and local concerts.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
